blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The mayor of Pampanga’s Magalang town on Thursday said she has already divested from a manpower firm following allegations of irregularity. The accusations stem from a conflict of interest complaint filed against her before the Office of the Ombudsman. Mayor Maria Lourdes “Malu” Lacson made the remark after the United Pilipino Against Crime and Corruption founder Pyra Lucas filed the complaint. The case includes alleged violation of Republic Act (RA) 3019 or the Anti Graft and Corrupt Practices Act against the mayor and other municipal officials.
